# Push Airtable product edits to Shopify

**Pattern:** Poll -> guard -> update · **Level:** Production · **Trigger:** Airtable poll

## What it does
When a row changes in an Airtable products table, pushes the edited title, tags and status to the matching Shopify product.

## Why it exists
Plenty of teams find it faster to merchandise in an Airtable grid than in Shopify's admin. This makes Airtable the editing surface and has Shopify follow — automatically, for changed rows only.

## Main flow
On Airtable Row Change -> Map Editable Fields -> Has Shopify ID? -> Update Shopify Product (unlinked row -> skip; failure -> Airtable errors table).

## Use it for
- A content team editing product copy/tags in Airtable
- Bulk draft/active status changes from a grid view
- Keeping Shopify metadata in step with an Airtable master

## You get
- Merchandise in Airtable, Shopify follows
- Only changed rows sync
- Unlinked rows are skipped, not errored

## Before first run
Connect credentials: Airtable Personal Access Token; Shopify Admin API access token.
Colour key: 🟦 entry · 🟫 app I/O · ⬜ logic · 🟩 output · 🟥 error rail.
Each node has its own doc card underneath — read those before editing.

## Try it now
This polls Airtable on an interval; sample rows (one linked, one draft) are pinned so you can test the guard with no credential. Sample data is pinned on the trigger, so hit **Execute Workflow** to watch it flow end to end before attaching a single credential. Right-click → Unpin when you go live.

## Credentials setup

Credentials are never bundled in a template. Every node that talks to an external service needs its own connection before the first real run — open the node, click the Credential dropdown, choose **Create new**.

**Airtable Personal Access Token**
Airtable → Builder hub → Personal access tokens → Create a token with data.records:read and data.records:write scopes on the base you're syncing. Paste it into n8n's Airtable Token credential.
_Gotcha:_ Field names are case-sensitive and must match your table's columns exactly, or writes fail with 422 UNKNOWN_FIELD_NAME.

**Shopify Admin API access token**
Shopify Admin → Settings → Apps and sales channels → Develop apps → create an app → Admin API access token.
_Gotcha:_ Grant read_orders / read_products / read_customers as needed; the webhook trigger silently fails to register without the matching read scope.

Set each credential up once; it is reusable across every workflow in your instance.

## Troubleshooting

**Nothing happens when the event should fire**
Cause: The workflow is still a draft, or its trigger is inactive.
Fix: Publish/activate it. The manual test URL is different from the production URL.

**A node shows a red triangle right after import**
Cause: No credential is attached yet.
Fix: Expected on a fresh import — open the node and attach a credential (see the Credentials note).

**Nothing triggers when I edit a row**
Cause: The trigger watches the 'Last Modified' field — the row must actually change that field.
Fix: Add a 'Last Modified time' field to the table and point the trigger at it; plain edits to other fields may not bump it depending on config.

**Price or stock edits don't reach Shopify**
Cause: This template syncs product-level fields only.
Fix: Title/tags/status are product-level. Variant price and inventory use Shopify's variant/inventory APIs — out of scope here by design.

**Provider returns 429**
Cause: You are hitting the API rate limit.
Fix: The node already retries with backoff; widen the schedule interval or lower the batch size to stay under quota.

Still stuck? The **Executions** tab shows the exact node that failed and the data going into it — start there.

## Design decisions

The trigger is a poll, not a push, because Airtable has no native per-row webhook in this node — the sticky says so plainly rather than implying real-time. The Shopify update is scoped to product-level fields (title/tags/status) that the Shopify node can actually write; variant price and inventory are deliberately excluded because faking them through the wrong endpoint would be the kind of untruthful shortcut this catalog avoids. The unlinked-row branch is a real skip so draft rows don't error every poll.

## Practice exercises

Already production-shaped — deepen it:

1. Write the Shopify product ID back onto new Airtable rows after their first create.
2. Add a 'Sync' checkbox column and only push rows where it's ticked.
3. Record a 'Last Synced' timestamp on the row after a successful push.

## 🛠 Customize me

The watched table and trigger field (`Last Modified`) are on **On Airtable Row Change**. Editable fields (title/tags/status) map in **Map Editable Fields**; the row must carry the Shopify product ID. This syncs product-level fields only — variant price/inventory need Shopify's variant/inventory APIs. Write the Shopify ID back onto new rows after their first create.

## 🔐 Security

The Airtable PAT needs `data.records:read` on the Products table; the Shopify token needs `write_products` scoped to products. A bad row edit will overwrite the live Shopify product — consider a 'Sync' gate before pushing. Keep both credentials out of node parameters.
